items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: So I didn't know really how good he could play until we went off to Cincinnati and then I found out what a real good trombone man he was.

ctx.x: I thought he played Neomaraka with you.

No, no. He played a couple of times with us at Paddock to place Howard. What about Frog? Did you ever work with Frog or anything? No, that was the first time I would work with Frog. When? Was on his last trip to Cincinnati. Oh, cool. Yeah, the first time I would work with him.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Frog, yeah. Well, he played with us.

ctx.x: Oh, I know what you mean by Derek, or Bob, Frog.

Frog, yeah. Well, he played with us. And, uh... And at that time, Dregg happened to be sick. We had, uh, Adams, Classy Adams, on bass. So after that, we, uh, came on back home and... That's where George had taken sick. Wasn't feeling any too well. He said he was feeling too bad to travel too much. On them strenuous trips like that, you know? Well, anyway... That's when Larry... That's when Larry... Started this, uh, jazz thing off. But he was having, uh... Just piano playing... Until he ran into punch. I had this…
Now, you were sick yourself around about this time, weren't you?
